measurement_notes.scope: Tracked original deals in calendar years 2019–2026, 2026 through November 21. Includes first contracts, tracked standard free agents and extensions. Deal is the unit; a later decision is a different observation.
measurement_notes.salary_path: Changes are adjacent dollar differences divided by year-one salary. Flat and 5%/8% bands use a 0.12 percentage point tolerance, so salaries rising at the fixed year-one step keep the same label across years. One-year deals are separate.
measurement_notes.salary_evidence: A unique sum matches the reported signing total using salary and option observations, a named contract report, or a published schedule. A snapshot can include incentives or trade changes. Unknown paths are retained.
measurement_notes.minimum: One- or two-year full-season minimum-scale amounts. Pay-scale match does not prove which spending exception was used. Prorated minimums without verifiable terms remain unclassified.
measurement_notes.bird_resigning: Probable or confirmed Bird/Early Bird re-signings. Five-year signing, or a reported return and two same-team salary seasons. This catches some cap-room returns and misses rights carried through trades. Shapes are excluded from the funding classification.
measurement_notes.options: None documented means no identified option in the sources used for the row. Some endings were observed through an incomplete decision list. Unknown means the original clause cannot be classified with the available terms. Salary guarantees are separate.
measurement_notes.decision_time: An exact day is the day reported by the cited source. For undated decisions the file gives a documented deadline or a latest-by recap date when available.
measurement_notes.injuries: Recent injury counts use the repository public NBA/ESPN injury research for 2023–24 through 2025–26; zero means no missed regular-season game in that source. Earlier injury data are spot examples; availability includes all absences.
